_meta.rule: A house LOCATES a scene or REFINES an exact reading. It may never generate an independent keyword-list sentence. `scene` is the lived arena the house points to; `refine` is a clause fragment that only attaches to an exact-lane situation.

cc/house/1.scene: how you show up, your body, the first move you make
cc/house/1.refine: and it lands in how you carry yourself into the room

cc/house/2.scene: what you earn, own, and value, and the felt sense of your own worth
cc/house/2.refine: and it settles into what you own and what you feel you're worth

cc/house/3.scene: the daily back-and-forth: messages, errands, siblings, the near streets
cc/house/3.refine: and it plays out in the small exchanges of an ordinary day

cc/house/4.scene: home, family, and the ground you retreat to
cc/house/4.refine: and it reaches all the way back to home and family

cc/house/5.scene: what you make for the joy of it: play, romance, children, creative risk
cc/house/5.refine: and it shows up in what you make and who you flirt with

cc/house/6.scene: the work, the routine, the body's upkeep, the daily fixing of things
cc/house/6.refine: and it lands in the day's work and how your body holds up

cc/house/7.scene: the one across from you: partners, close others, open rivals
cc/house/7.refine: and it turns toward the person across the table from you

cc/house/8.scene: what you share and can't fully control: joint money, deep trust, other people's power
cc/house/8.refine: and it goes where money, trust, and control are shared rather than yours alone

cc/house/9.scene: the wider view: travel, study, belief, the meaning you reach for
cc/house/9.refine: and it opens onto the bigger picture you're trying to make sense of

cc/house/10.scene: your public standing, career, and what you're known for
cc/house/10.refine: and it shows up out in the open, in your work and reputation

cc/house/11.scene: the crowd you belong to: friends, networks, the future you're building toward
cc/house/11.refine: and it moves through your friendships and the future you're aiming at

cc/house/12.scene: the private, the unseen, rest, and what you keep behind closed doors
cc/house/12.refine: and it happens quietly, out of view, in your own inner rooms
